turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My nephew wants a dinosaur birthday cake and I'm weighing up how to pull it off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could carve a sheet cake into a dinosaur shape and cover it in green buttercream.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a simpler idea, a plain round cake with plastic dinosaur toys stomping across the top.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a volcano cake with orange icing dripping down and little dinosaurs around the base.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My sister also suggested dinosaur shaped cookies instead of a cake at all.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a kid, the volcano is probably the showstopper, it's fun and very forgiving. The toy topped cake is the low stress option, and the cookies could be a sweet extra rather than the main event.
